description: social.md §13 tags and wiki: page membership (V1–V5), candidates (genesisOK, editOK, tagCreation), the cycle cut, depth, the canonical head (moderator #tag.head, then depth desc, K desc, uri asc), removed tags, isTag, the flags parentUnavailable and ancestor altered (§13.2), and relevance and application (§13.3: own tags, tag votes, OP3/OP4, restrictions). input: {fold: FoldInput}. expected: wiki ({slug: {canonical, exists, applicable, partial, history, unmerged, candidates: {uri: {depth, parents, altered, parentUnavailable}}}}), tagRel ({post uri: {slug: rel}}, non-zero only) and applies ({post uri: [slug]}) (testdata/vectors/README.md, social section). Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.

vectors.name: linear-chain-head
vectors.note: a linear history: genesis r1, then r2 and r3, each naming the head it edited. Every author passes createTag and wikiEdit (gates 0), so all three are candidates; the canonical revision is the tip of the longest chain (depth 2), and the history follows the edges back to r1

vectors.name: fork-by-depth-then-K-then-uri
vectors.note: three forked pages. depth: alice's and bob's edits both fork from the genesis; carol's edit of alice's makes the deepest chain (depth 2), which wins; bob's tip is an unmerged edit. karma: two edits at depth 1 by alice (K 1: one seed upvote) and bob (K 2: two seed upvotes); bob's wins on K although alice's uri is smaller. uri: carol and dave (K 0) tie on depth and K, so the smallest uri (carol's) wins

vectors.name: cycle-cut-at-the-greatest-uri
vectors.note: parents name uris, so a history can contain a cycle: alice's revision names carol's, carol's names bob's, and bob's (rewritten later) names alice's. The cut removes, in each cyclic strongly connected component, every edge from its greatest-uri member into the component: carol's revision (did:plc:carol… sorts last) loses its edge, which leaves the chain bob → alice → carol, so bob's revision (depth 2) is canonical. dave's revision names itself (a self-loop, which the cut removes too) and counts as an unmerged edit

vectors.name: moderator-tag-head
vectors.note: createTag = 1, so only authorities create pages; edits need wikiEdit = 0. chosen: mona's #tag.head names r2, a candidate with its current CID, so r2 is canonical although r3 is deeper (r3 counts as an unmerged edit). other-page: the head names a revision of another slug, which is no candidate of this page, so the deepest candidate stands. gated: the head names carol's genesis, which fails createTag (K 0 < 1) and is no candidate; adam's genesis is canonical

vectors.name: removed-tag
vectors.note: mona's #tag{removed: true} makes gone non-existent although it has a canonical revision, so bob's own tag gives relevance 1 but does not apply; adam (rank 2) restores kept over mona's removal; ghost has a tag: subject but no revision, so it has no canonical revision and does not exist

vectors.name: deleted-parent-gives-a-flagged-root-gated-as-genesis
vectors.note: createTag = 1 (only authorities pass), wikiEdit = 0. x: both edits name a deleted revision, so par(r) = ∅; mona's enters Cand through genesisOK and is flagged parentUnavailable, alice's (wikiEdit only) is no candidate. y: mike's genesis is hidden by adam (V3), so it is on no page; adam's edit is a flagged root, alice's is no candidate. z: alice's genesis fails createTag, so bob's edit of it has no candidate parent and is no candidate either (a fake parent cannot bypass createTag); z has no canonical revision

vectors.name: ancestor-altered
vectors.note: bob's revision names alice's genesis with the CID of its earlier version (the genesis was rewritten afterwards): the edge still exists (ancestry is by uri) and is marked altered; carol's edge to bob's revision carries the current CID

vectors.name: tagCreation-moderators
vectors.note: tagCreation = moderators: a genesis revision needs an authority author (createTag = 0 is ignored), so alice's genesis is no candidate and bob's edit of it neither; mona's genesis is, and alice's edit of it (wikiEdit 0) is the canonical head

vectors.name: isTag-false
vectors.note: a page whose canonical revision has isTag = false exists but is not applicable, so carol's own tag gives relevance 1 and does not apply; the canonical revision decides, so now-a-tag (isTag false at genesis, true at the head) applies

vectors.name: relevance-boundaries
vectors.note: rel(p, t) = own + votes, applies ⇔ applicable(t) ∧ rel > 0; voters are seeds with KP 0, so every vote has power ±1. p1: own tag, 1. p2: own tag (duplicates collapse, PO7) and one down vote, 0. p3: one up vote, 1. p4: up and down, 0. p5: carol is restricted from tag, so her own tag gives 0. p6: dave (a granted seed) is restricted from tag, so his vote is ignored. p7: erin is a newcomer outside E, so her vote has no weight. p8: mona's conflicting entries for t are all ignored (OP4) and mike's equal strongUp entries collapse to one, 1. p9: an unknown value discards the entry (OP3). p10: own tag 1, alice's vote on her own post is ignored (O3), strongDown and down, −1. p11: an own tag with no page, relevance 1 that never applies. Tag votes on a comment are ignored (OP4)

vectors.name: tag-head-spellings-agree
vectors.note: the owner writes genesis r1 of slug w and r2 on top of it, citing r1's CID in base32 upper case (multibase B); two admins set the head of tag:w to r1, one with that spelling and one in canonical form. CIDs written in records compare by canonical form (social.md §0.4, §20.1 item 45): the heads agree, so r1 is canonical although r2 is deeper, and the edge r2 → r1 is not altered

vectors.name: canonical-tie-by-k
vectors.note: the K ≠ KP cast (approval mode, every user granted): abe and wes each write a genesis revision of slug t at the same time (depth 0 both). The tie-break after depth is the author's K (§13.2): wes has K 2 and abe K 1, so wes's revision is canonical; by KP (1 and 1) the smaller uri, abe's, would be

vectors.name: tag-vote-power-kp
vectors.note: the K ≠ KP cast: vera (K1 9, KP 10, K 9) votes strongUp for tag t on boosterl's post, with an opinion that carries only that tag vote. A tag vote weighs power(KP[voter], value) (§13.3): strong(10) = 2; reading K would give strong(9) = 1

vectors.name: history-tie-smallest-uri
vectors.note: two genesis revisions r1 and r2, and r3 naming both (the greater uri first). r3 is canonical (depth 1); its parents have equal depth 0, so the history steps to the smaller uri, r1. Both parents have an incoming edge, so nothing is unmerged

vectors.name: duplicate-parent-entries
vectors.note: r2 lists r1 twice, once with the CID of another record and once with r1's own; r3 lists r1 twice with r1's CID. Duplicate parents collapse to one edge (WR2), and the edge is altered when any of its entries carries another CID: r2 → r1 is altered, r3 → r1 is not

vectors.name: tag-votes-op3-before-op4
vectors.note: the owner's opinion on adam's post carries two entries for tag t, up and the unknown superUp. OP3 discards the unknown value first, then OP4 sees a single entry, so the vote counts: rel 1 (applying OP4 first would drop both conflicting entries)
